#### CUSTOM FUNCTIONS AND PACKAGES

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(psych)
library(car)
library(tidyverse)
library(effectsize)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(effects)
library(see)
library(ggrain)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(ggpattern)

# varDescribe: compact wrapper around psych::describe
# Detail = 1 (minimal), 2 (standard), 3 (full)
varDescribe <- function(Data, Detail = 2, Digits = 2) {
  t3 <- psych::describe(Data)
  t3 <- data.frame(t3)
  if (!is.null(Digits)) t3 <- round(t3, Digits)
  t2 <- t3[, c(1:5, 8, 9, 11, 12)]
  t1 <- t3[, c(2:4, 8, 9)]
  t  <- switch(Detail, t1, t2, t3)
  return(t)
}

# varDescribeBy: varDescribe split by a grouping variable
varDescribeBy <- function(Data, IVList) {
  by(Data, IVList, varDescribe)
}

# varRecode: replace levels of a vector by position
# Old and New must be equal-length vectors; NAs are preserved and flagged
varRecode <- function(Var, Old, New) {
  if (length(Old) != length(New))
    stop("Number of Old and New values do not match")
  NewVar <- rep(NA, length(Var))
  for (i in seq_along(Old)) {
    NewVar[Var == Old[i]] <- New[i]
  }
  if (sum(is.na(NewVar)) != sum(is.na(Var)))
    warning(sprintf(
      "%.0f NAs in original variable but %.0f NAs in recoded variable",
      sum(is.na(Var)), sum(is.na(NewVar))
    ))
  if (is.factor(Var)) NewVar <- as.factor(NewVar)
  return(NewVar)
}
```

#### LOADING AND CLEANING DATA

```{r data-cleaning}
d <- read.csv("/Users/vestnicholas/Documents/Projects/Integers/Dissertation/DATA/ADULTS/all_data.csv")
# Raw: 35,520 trials

d$SubID    <- d$StudentID
d$StudentID <- NULL

# --- Step 1: Remove participants with error rates > 45% ---
d_error <- d %>%
  group_by(SubID) %>%
  summarise(ErrorRate = mean(Accuracy, na.rm = TRUE))

exclusions <- c("2891", "2857", "9482", "4589", "3066", "3091")
d <- filter(d, !SubID %in% exclusions)

# --- Step 2: Remove inaccurate trials ---
d <- filter(d, Accuracy != 0)
# After accuracy filter: 28,219

# --- Step 3: Global RT cutoffs by presentation condition ---
# Sequential conditions: 50–3000 ms (allow faster manual responses)
# Simultaneous conditions: 200–3000 ms (display requires visual search)
d <- d %>%
  filter(
    (configuration %in% c("sequential-grouped", "sequential-ungrouped") &
       RT >= 50 & RT <= 3000) |
    (configuration %in% c("simultaneous-grouped", "simultaneous-ungrouped") &
       RT >= 200 & RT <= 3000)
  )
# Trials removed by global cutoff: (28219 - 26979) / 28219 = 4.4%

# --- Step 4: Per-participant SD trimming (±3 SD within SubID × Comparison_Type × condition) ---
d <- d %>%
  group_by(SubID, Comparison_Type, configuration) %>%
  mutate(mean_rt = mean(RT), sd_rt = sd(RT)) %>%
  filter(RT >= mean_rt - 3 * sd_rt, RT <= mean_rt + 3 * sd_rt) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-mean_rt, -sd_rt)
# Trials removed by SD trimming: (26979 - 26400) / 26979 = 2.1%
# Final N: 26,400 trials

# --- Contrast coding: shared across all analyses below ---
config_levels  <- c("sequential-ungrouped", "sequential-grouped",
                    "simultaneous-ungrouped", "simultaneous-grouped")
order_vals     <- c(.5, -.5, .5, -.5)   # intermixed = .5, blocked = -.5
present_vals   <- c(-.5, -.5, .5, .5)   # sequential = -.5, simultaneous = .5
order_labels   <- c("Intermixed", "Blocked", "Intermixed", "Blocked")
present_labels <- c("Sequential", "Sequential", "Simultaneous", "Simultaneous")

d$Order            <- varRecode(d$configuration, config_levels, order_vals)
d$Presentation     <- varRecode(d$configuration, config_levels, present_vals)
d$Order_STR        <- varRecode(d$configuration, config_levels, order_labels)
d$Presentation_STR <- varRecode(d$configuration, config_levels, present_labels)
d$Predicate_C      <- varRecode(d$Choose_GL, c("Greater", "Lesser"), c(-.5, .5))

# Distance centered within each Comparison_Type
d <- d %>%
  group_by(Comparison_Type) %>%
  mutate(Distance_C = Distance - mean(Distance, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Near/Far binary for distance
d <- d %>%
  mutate(
    Distance_01 = case_when(
      Comparison_Type %in% c("Positive", "Negative") & Distance > 4 ~ "Far",
      Comparison_Type %in% c("Positive", "Negative") & Distance <= 4 ~ "Near",
      Comparison_Type == "Mixed" & Distance >= 6 ~ "Far",
      Comparison_Type == "Mixed" & Distance < 6  ~ "Near",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

```{r distance-inferential-group}
# ---- Group-level LMERs: RT ~ Distance × Order × Presentation ----

# Helper: shared plot theme for distance effect figures
de_plot <- function(data, title_str) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Distance, y = RT, color = Order_STR)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
    facet_wrap(~ Presentation_STR) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(200, 3000), breaks = seq(200, 3000, by = 400)) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, 8), breaks = 1:8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#E69F00")) +
    labs(
      title = title_str,
      x = "Distance", y = "Reaction Time (ms)", color = "Order"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
}

## Positive pairs
d_pos <- filter(d, Comparison_Type == "Positive")

m_pos <- lmer(
  RT ~ Distance_C * Order * Presentation + Predicate_C +
    (1 + Distance_C * Order + Predicate_C | SubID),
  data    = d_pos,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                        optCtrl   = list(maxfun = 2e6),
                        check.nobs.vs.nRE = "ignore")
)
anova(as_lmerModLmerTest(m_pos))
summary(m_pos)
Anova(m_pos, type = "III")

de_plot(d_pos, "Positive-Positive Pairs")

## Negative pairs
d_neg <- filter(d, Comparison_Type == "Negative")

m_neg <- lmer(
  RT ~ Distance_C * Order * Presentation + Predicate_C +
    (1 + Distance_C * Order + Predicate_C | SubID),
  data    = d_neg,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                        optCtrl   = list(maxfun = 2e6),
                        check.nobs.vs.nRE = "ignore")
)
anova(as_lmerModLmerTest(m_neg))
summary(m_neg)
Anova(m_neg, type = "III")

de_plot(d_neg, "Negative-Negative Pairs")

## Mixed pairs — omnibus
d_mixed <- filter(d, Comparison_Type == "Mixed")

m_mixed <- lmer(
  RT ~ Distance_C * Order * Presentation + Predicate_C +
    (1 + Distance_C:Order + Predicate_C | SubID),
  data    = d_mixed,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "nloptwrap",
                        optCtrl   = list(maxfun = 100000),
                        check.nobs.vs.nRE = "ignore")

anova(as_lmerModLmerTest(m_mixed))
summary(m_mixed)

de_plot(d_mixed, "Mixed Pairs")

# Mixed: simple effects via re-parametrized contrasts
# Each model shifts the reference cell to one of the four conditions

## Simultaneous-Intermixed as reference
d_mixed$Order_SI        <- varRecode(d_mixed$Order,        c(-.5, .5), c(-1, 0))
d_mixed$Presentation_SI <- varRecode(d_mixed$Presentation, c(-.5, .5), c(-1, 0))
m_SI <- lmer(
  RT ~ Distance_C * Order_SI * Presentation_SI + Predicate_C +

  data    = d_mixed,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "nloptwrap", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000),
                        check.nobs.vs.nRE = "ignore")
)
summary(m_SI)

## Simultaneous-Blocked as reference
d_mixed$Order_SB        <- varRecode(d_mixed$Order,        c(-.5, .5), c(0, 1))
d_mixed$Presentation_SB <- varRecode(d_mixed$Presentation, c(-.5, .5), c(-1, 0))
m_SB <- lmer(
  RT ~ Distance_C * Order_SB * Presentation_SB + Predicate_C +
    (1 + Distance_C:Order + Predicate_C | SubID),
  data    = d_mixed,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "nloptwrap", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000),
                        check.nobs.vs.nRE = "ignore")
)
summary(m_SB)

## Sequential-Intermixed as reference
d_mixed$Order_SQI        <- varRecode(d_mixed$Order,        c(-.5, .5), c(-1, 0))
d_mixed$Presentation_SQI <- varRecode(d_mixed$Presentation, c(-.5, .5), c(0, 1))
m_SQI <- lmer(
  RT ~ Distance_C * Order_SQI * Presentation_SQI + Predicate_C +
```

```{r distance-inferential-individual}
# ---- Individual-level distance effects ----
# Per-participant OLS: RT ~ Distance_C + Predicate_C
# Extracts beta, p-value, and 95% CI for Distance_C
# Classifies participants as Inverse / Standard / None using ±0.25 SD threshold

extract_de_betas <- function(df) {
  results <- data.frame(
    SubID          = character(),
    beta_Distance  = numeric(),
    p_value        = numeric(),
    lower_CI       = numeric(),
    upper_CI       = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  for (subj in unique(df$SubID)) {
    subj_data <- filter(df, SubID == subj)
    model     <- lm(RT ~ Distance_C + Predicate_C, data = subj_data)
    ci        <- confint(model, "Distance_C", level = 0.95)
    results   <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      SubID         = subj,
      beta_Distance = coef(model)["Distance_C"],
      p_value       = summary(model)$coefficients["Distance_C", "Pr(>|t|)"],
      lower_CI      = ci[1],
      upper_CI      = ci[2]
    ))
  }
  return(results)
}

classify_de <- function(df) {
  threshold_above <-  0.25 * SD(df$beta_Distance)
  threshold_below <- -0.25 * SD(df$beta_Distance)
  df %>%
    mutate(
      DE_.25 = case_when(
        beta_Distance > threshold_above ~ "Inverse",
        beta_Distance < threshold_below ~ "Standard",
        TRUE                            ~ "None"
      ),
      DE_.25 = factor(DE_.25, levels = c("Inverse", "Standard", "None"))
    )
}

## Positive
d_pos$Predicate_C <- varRecode(d_pos$Choose_GL, c("Greater", "Lesser"), c(-.5, .5))
de_pos <- classify_de(extract_de_betas(d_pos))
table(de_pos$DE_.25)

## Negative
d_neg$Predicate_C <- varRecode(d_neg$Choose_GL, c("Greater", "Lesser"), c(-.5, .5))
de_neg <- classify_de(extract_de_betas(d_neg))
table(de_neg$DE_.25)

## Mixed — overall
d_mixed$Predicate_C <- varRecode(d_mixed$Choose_GL, c("Greater", "Lesser"), c(-.5, .5))
de_mixed <- classify_de(extract_de_betas(d_mixed))
table(de_mixed$DE_.25)

# Scatter: individual distance betas for Mixed pairs
ggplot(de_mixed, aes(x = factor(SubID), y = beta_Distance)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
           ymin = -10.44, ymax = 10.44, fill = "lightgrey",  alpha = 0.5) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
           ymin = 10.44,  ymax = Inf,  fill = "lightcoral",  alpha = 0.3) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
           ymin = -Inf,   ymax = -10.44, fill = "lightgreen", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-120, 120)) +
  labs(
    title = "Distance Effects by Participant (Mixed Pairs)",
    x = "Participant (SubID)", y = "Beta for Distance"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.line    = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)
  )

## Mixed — by condition
conditions <- c("simultaneous-ungrouped", "simultaneous-grouped",
                "sequential-ungrouped",   "sequential-grouped")

de_mixed_by_cond <- map_dfr(conditions, function(cond) {
  df_cond <- filter(d_mixed, configuration == cond)
  classify_de(extract_de_betas(df_cond)) %>%
    mutate(configuration = cond)
})

de_mixed_by_cond %>%
  group_by(configuration) %>%
  summarise(table = list(table(DE_.25)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pull(table) %>%
  setNames(conditions)

## Proportion plots: Distance Effects

# Overall (Positive, Negative, Mixed)
de_prop_overall <- data.frame(
  Comparison = rep(c("a Positive", "b Negative", "c Mixed"), each = 3),
  Category   = rep(c("c None", "b Standard", "a Inverse"), times = 3),
  Proportion = c(0.15, 0.65, 0.20,
                 0.15, 0.78, 0.07,
                 0.24, 0.37, 0.39)
)

ggplot(de_prop_overall, aes(x = Comparison, y = Proportion, fill = Category)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", stat = "identity", color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(Proportion, accuracy = 0.1)),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            color = "white", size = 3) +
  labs(x = "Comparison Type", y = "Proportion") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#7A4FD9", "#C084F5", "#7A6C8A")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14)

# By condition (Mixed pairs only)
de_prop_cond <- data.frame(
  Comparison = rep(
    c("a Simultaneous-Intermixed", "b Simultaneous-Blocked",
      "c Sequential-Intermixed",  "d Sequential-Blocked"),
    each = 3
  ),
  Category   = rep(c("c None", "b Standard", "a Inverse"), times = 4),
  Proportion = c(0.23, 0.43, 0.33,
                 0.20, 0.46, 0.33,
                 0.12, 0.42, 0.46,
                 0.21, 0.33, 0.46)
)

ggplot(de_prop_cond, aes(x = Comparison, y = Proportion, fill = Category)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", stat = "identity", color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(Proportion, accuracy = 0.1)),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            color = "white", size = 3) +
  labs(x = "Condition", y = "Proportion") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#7A4FD9", "#C084F5", "#7A6C8A")) +
```

#### ANALYSES: SEMANTIC CONGRUENCE EFFECTS

```{r sce-descriptives}
# SCE analyses restricted to Positive and Negative pairs (Size is undefined for Mixed)
d_sce <- d %>%
  filter(Size != "", Comparison_Type != "Mixed")

describeBy(d_sce$RT, d_sce$Comparison_Type)

# Overall RT by Comparison_Type
d_sce %>%
  group_by(Comparison_Type) %>%
  summarise(mean_RT = mean(RT, na.rm = TRUE), se_RT = sd(RT, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()))

# RT by Comparison_Type × Predicate × Size
d_sce %>%
  group_by(Comparison_Type, Choose_GL, Size) %>%
  summarise(mean_RT = mean(RT, na.rm = TRUE), se_RT = sd(RT, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()))

# RT for Negative pairs by condition
d_sce %>%
  filter(Comparison_Type == "Negative") %>%
  group_by(configuration) %>%
  summarise(mean_RT = mean(RT, na.rm = TRUE), se_RT = sd(RT, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop")

# RT for Negative pairs by condition × Predicate × Size
d_sce %>%
  filter(Comparison_Type == "Negative") %>%
  group_by(configuration, Choose_GL, Size) %>%
  summarise(mean_RT = mean(RT, na.rm = TRUE), se_RT = sd(RT, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop")

# RT for Positive pairs by Presentation × Predicate × Size
d_sce %>%
  filter(Comparison_Type == "Positive") %>%
  group_by(Presentation, Choose_GL, Size) %>%
  summarise(mean_RT = mean(RT, na.rm = TRUE), se_RT = sd(RT, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop")
```

```{r sce-inferential-group}
# ---- Group-level LMERs: RT ~ Size × Predicate × Order × Presentation ----

d_sce <- d_sce %>%
  mutate(
    Size_C      = varRecode(Size, c("Small", "Large"), c(-.5, .5)),
    Predicate_C = varRecode(Choose_GL, c("Greater", "Lesser"), c(-.5, .5)),
    Order       = varRecode(configuration, config_levels, order_vals),
    Presentation = varRecode(configuration, config_levels, present_vals)
  )

## Positive pairs
d_pos_sce <- filter(d_sce, Comparison_Type == "Positive")

m_pos_sce <- lmer(
  RT ~ Size_C * Predicate_C * Order * Presentation +
    (1 + Size_C:Predicate_C:Order | SubID),
  data    = d_pos_sce,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                        optCtrl   = list(maxfun = 2e6),
                        check.nobs.vs.nRE = "ignore")
)
anova(as_lmerModLmerTest(m_pos_sce))
summary(m_pos_sce)

# Simple effect: simultaneous
d_pos_sim <- filter(d_pos_sce, Presentation == .5)
m_pos_sim <- lmer(
  RT ~ Size_C * Predicate_C * Order + (1 + Size_C:Predicate_C:Order | SubID),
  data    = d_pos_sim,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e6),
                        check.nobs.vs.nRE = "ignore")
)
anova(as_lmerModLmerTest(m_pos_sim))
summary(m_pos_sim)

# Simple effect: sequential
d_pos_seq <- filter(d_pos_sce, Presentation == -.5)
m_pos_seq <- lmer(
  RT ~ Size_C * Predicate_C * Order + (1 + Size_C:Predicate_C:Order | SubID),
  data    = d_pos_seq,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e6),
                        check.nobs.vs.nRE = "ignore")
)
anova(as_lmerModLmerTest(m_pos_seq))
summary(m_pos_seq)

## Negative pairs — omnibus
d_neg_sce <- filter(d_sce, Comparison_Type == "Negative")

m_neg_sce <- lmer(
  RT ~ Size_C * Predicate_C * Order * Presentation +
    (1 + Size_C:Predicate_C:Order | SubID),
  data    = d_neg_sce,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                        optCtrl   = list(maxfun = 2e6),
                        check.nobs.vs.nRE = "ignore")
)
anova(as_lmerModLmerTest(m_neg_sce))
summary(m_neg_sce)

# Negative pairs — simple effects (same re-parametrization logic as distance models)
d_neg_sce$Order_SI        <- varRecode(d_neg_sce$Order,        c(-.5, .5), c(-1, 0))
d_neg_sce$Presentation_SI <- varRecode(d_neg_sce$Presentation, c(-.5, .5), c(-1, 0))
m_neg_SI <- lmer(
  RT ~ Size_C * Predicate_C * Order_SI * Presentation_SI +
    (1 + Size_C:Predicate_C:Order_SI | SubID),
  data    = d_neg_sce,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e6),
                        check.nobs.vs.nRE = "ignore")
)
summary(m_neg_SI)
anova(as_lmerModLmerTest(m_neg_SI))

d_neg_sce$Order_SB        <- varRecode(d_neg_sce$Order,        c(-.5, .5), c(0, 1))
d_neg_sce$Presentation_SB <- varRecode(d_neg_sce$Presentation, c(-.5, .5), c(-1, 0))

)

anova(as_lmerModLmerTest(m_neg_SB))

d_neg_sce$Order_SQI        <- varRecode(d_neg_sce$Order,        c(-.5, .5), c(-1, 0))
```

```{r sce-inferential-individual}
# ---- Individual-level SCE ----
# Per-participant OLS: RT ~ Predicate_C:Size_C
# Classifies participants as Inverse / Standard / None using ±0.25 SD threshold

extract_sce_betas <- function(df) {
  results <- data.frame(
    SubID    = character(),
    beta_SCE = numeric(),
    p_value  = numeric(),
    lower_CI = numeric(),
    upper_CI = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  for (subj in unique(df$SubID)) {
    subj_data <- filter(df, SubID == subj)
    model     <- lm(RT ~ Predicate_C:Size_C, data = subj_data)
    ci        <- confint(model, "Predicate_C:Size_C", level = 0.95)
    results   <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      SubID    = subj,
      beta_SCE = coef(model)["Predicate_C:Size_C"],
      p_value  = summary(model)$coefficients["Predicate_C:Size_C", "Pr(>|t|)"],
      lower_CI = ci[1],
      upper_CI = ci[2]
    ))
  }
  return(results)
}

classify_sce <- function(df) {
  threshold_above <-  0.25 * SD(df$beta_SCE)
  threshold_below <- -0.25 * SD(df$beta_SCE)
  df %>%
    mutate(
      SCE_.25 = case_when(
        beta_SCE < threshold_below ~ "Inverse",
        beta_SCE > threshold_above ~ "Standard",
        TRUE                       ~ "None"
      ),
      SCE_.25 = factor(SCE_.25, levels = c("Inverse", "Standard", "None"))
    )
}

## Positive pairs
sce_pos <- classify_sce(extract_sce_betas(d_pos_sce))
table(sce_pos$SCE_.25)

## Negative pairs — overall
sce_neg <- classify_sce(extract_sce_betas(d_neg_sce))
table(sce_neg$SCE_.25)

## Negative pairs — by condition
sce_neg_by_cond <- map_dfr(conditions, function(cond) {
  df_cond <- filter(d_neg_sce, configuration == cond)
  classify_sce(extract_sce_betas(df_cond)) %>%
    mutate(configuration = cond)
})

sce_neg_by_cond %>%
  group_by(configuration) %>%
  summarise(table = list(table(SCE_.25)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pull(table) %>%
  setNames(conditions)

## Proportion plots: SCE

# Overall (Positive, Negative)
sce_prop_overall <- data.frame(
  Comparison = rep(c("a Positive", "b Negative"), each = 3),
  Category   = rep(c("c None", "b Standard", "a Inverse"), times = 2),
  Proportion = c(0.17, 0.46, 0.37,
                 0.13, 0.63, 0.24)
)

ggplot(sce_prop_overall, aes(x = Comparison, y = Proportion, fill = Category)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", stat = "identity", color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(Proportion, accuracy = 0.1)),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            color = "white", size = 3) +
  labs(x = "Comparison Type", y = "Proportion") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4F9E4D", "#6CD991", "#5D7C6A")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14)

# By condition (Negative pairs)
sce_prop_cond <- data.frame(
  Comparison = rep(
    c("a Simultaneous-Intermixed", "b Simultaneous-Blocked",
      "c Sequential-Intermixed",  "d Sequential-Blocked"),
    each = 3
  ),

  Proportion = c(0.27, 0.40, 0.33,

)

ggplot(sce_prop_cond, aes(x = Comparison, y = Proportion, fill = Category)) +
```
